links.outcome: Readability indices (Flesch, FKGL, SMOG, Coleman-Liau) of AI-generated Dutch discharge brochures
links.effect: Brochures required high school- to college-level comprehension, though the authors consider this likely an overestimate due to context-specific reasons and features of the Dutch language.
links.quote: Readability analysis indicated that brochures require high school- to college-level comprehension, but this is likely an overestimation due to context-specific reasons as well as features inherent to the Dutch language.

unlisted_practices: Machine translation (DeepL) of LLM-generated patient materials into Dutch
Expert emergency physician rating of AI-generated discharge brochures on quality, accessibility, clarity, correctness and usability

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the quality and readability of GPT-4-generated and translated emergency department patient discharge information via expert clinician review, without comparing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
